prior_contract.conditional_nuisance: Original source conditional nuisance prior at retained source mass, eta, chi_eff, z; no hidden-spin prior change
prior_contract.density_convention: Native retained prior proportional to (1+z)^2 J(Mc_source,eta) p_chi(chi|q) p_native_DL(DL(z)) dDLcommon/dz. No population rho.

weight_definition: w4 proportional to prior-corrected native posterior weights in dMc_source deta dchi_eff dz. Native distance prior removed event-wise; NO rho embedded. Native posterior weights retained separately; pi_x proportional to posterior_weights/w4.
